title: Among customers who paid in CZK and made transactions at gas stations in th
question: Among customers who paid in CZK and made transactions at gas stations in the Czech Republic during the morning of August 26, 2012, how many had total consumption below 25,000 in 2012?

prediction.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT c.XCL_001
  FROM customers AS c
  INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
  INNER JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.XCL_015 = g.XCL_004
  WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'CZK'
    AND g.XCL_006 = 'CZE'
    AND t.XCL_011 = '2012-08-26'
    AND t.XCL_012 < '12:00:00'
  GROUP BY c.XCL_001
) AS eligible
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON eligible.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
WHERE SUBSTRING(ym.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2012'
GROUP BY eligible.XCL_001
HAVING SUM(ym.XCL_021) < 25000

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT c.XCL_001
  FROM customers AS c
  INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
  INNER JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.XCL_015 = g.XCL_004
  WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'CZK'
    AND g.XCL_006 = 'CZE'
    AND t.XCL_011 = '2012-08-26'
    AND t.XCL_012 < '12:00:00'
  GROUP BY c.XCL_001
) AS eligible
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON eligible.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
WHERE SUBSTRING(ym.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2012'
GROUP BY eligible.XCL_001
HAVING SUM(ym.XCL_021) < 25000
